column1: # The platform table: a DAT's provider and header name, and the front-end folder name its `{platform}` token gives.
# Folder names are ES-DE system names, as listed in ES-DE's `es_systems.xml` (MIT licence):
# RomM recognises these names as folder names, either as its own platform slugs or as aliases:
# Where ES-DE has several folders for one system (genesis and megadrive, segacd and megacd), the one RomM also uses as
# its slug is chosen. Systems ES-DE has no folder for are left out, so their DATs have no `{platform}`.
# DAT names are header names without dump-format qualifiers such as "(Headered)" or "(Decrypted)", which a lookup
# ignores. Each line is: provider, a tab, DAT name, a tab, folder name. Every provider and DAT name pair is unique.
